title: Sum of Digits

content.problemStatement:
Sum of Digits

Write a program to accept a number as input and print the sum of its digits.

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

hints: Look for mathematical symmetries, invariants, or modulo arithmetic properties.
When dealing with large numbers or digits, extract digits using % 10 and / 10 in a loop.
Consider edge cases like 0, negative numbers, and standard integer overflow boundaries.
learningObjectives: Master core algorithmic concepts and pattern recognition for Sum of Digits.
Analyze time and space complexity trade-offs to meet optimal constraint benchmarks.
Formulate robust solutions addressing edge cases including boundary values and empty sets.
